items.title: BREAKING: PM Modi Puts Nandan Nilekani in Charge of Fixing India's Exam System
items.summary:
A day after Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned following a 36-day agitation over the NEET UG 2026 paper leak, PM Modi announced a high-powered task force on examination reforms, chaired by Nandan Nilekani. The lineup spans technology, engineering, logistics, intelligence, and academia, framed less like an education committee and more like a systems integration project.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down who's on the task force, the parallel fast-track courts bill for paper leak cases, and why the 2024 Radhakrishnan committee's 101 recommendations still haven't been fully implemented two years later.

items.title: HUGE: Bengaluru's Own State Just Skipped India's Homegrown AI for Anthropic
items.summary:
Karnataka's Home and IT Minister Priyank Kharge just announced two dedicated working groups with Anthropic, not India's own Sarvam AI, to identify priority use cases across governance, education, and innovation. The discussion went beyond a generic AI pitch: government data sets, Claude certifications for students and enterprises, and startup ecosystem access all came up.

In this episode of Front Page, we break down why Bengaluru's home state skipped homegrown AI for a US frontier lab, how this contrasts with Bihar's Sarvam-first approach, and what it signals about India's AI governance strategy splitting into two philosophies.

items.title: REPORT: India’s ₹1 Lakh Crore Plan Targets 3.5 Crore Jobs
items.summary:
India’s government has approved a ₹1 lakh crore employment-linked incentive scheme targeting 3.5 crore jobs. The plan combines support for first-time employees with payments to employers that expand their workforce. 

In this episode of Front Page, we break down the scheme’s two-part structure, including incentives of up to ₹15,000 for eligible first-time employees, payments of up to ₹3,000 per additional worker for employers, the six-month headcount requirement, the August 2025 to July 2027 timeline, and the wider employment and MSME context.

items.title: TRAP: India Is Training the Robots That Could Replace Its Workers | Point Break
items.summary:
Physical AI is creating a new global demand for human movement, judgement and skill. India has the scale and diversity to supply that training data, but the value, ownership and protection of the workers creating it remain unresolved. 

In this episode of Point Break, Antara Gupta sits down with Mythily Ramesh - Co-Founder & MD at Next Wealth, Manish Agarwal - Co-Founder of Humyn Labs and Saravanan Balasundaram Founder & CEO of Han Digital Solutions, to break down why robots need real-world multisensory human data, how Indian workers are training physical AI systems, why India could become a global AI factory, and whether the country is repeating the outsourcing pattern of call centres and data annotation. The conversation examines robotic training across farms, factories, warehouses, and homes; the role of behavioural intelligence; the growth of machine learning operations; the potential expansion of India’s physical AI workforce from 2.5 lakh to 10 lakh by 2032; and the rise of teleoperation as a new opportunity for skilled Indian workers. It also explores the Amazon Go human-in-the-loop debate, worker consent and disclosure, privacy, data ownership, physical intelligence as a new asset class, and whether India can build its own intelligence layer instead of remaining a low-cost service provider for foreign AI companies.

items.title: How Autonomous AI Is Transforming Chip and System Design
items.summary:
AI factories demand increasingly complex chips—delivered faster than ever. See how NVIDIA and leaders across the EDA ecosystem are advancing autonomous engineering across design, verification, physical implementation, signoff, and system design.
Discover how Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA, and NVIDIA technologies—including NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo, CUDA-X libraries, and accelerated computing—are helping engineers reduce design iterations and accelerate innovation from chips to systems.

Resources:
NVIDIA Expands NVIDIA Agent Toolkit With NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo and CUDA-X Libraries: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-expands-nvidia-agent-toolkit-with-nvidia-physicsnemo-and-cuda-x-libraries-to-transform-how-the-world-engineers-designs-and-builds

Explore NVIDIA solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/industries/semiconductor/
